request.requirement: Create a CRUD todo API with SQLite persistence. Use python and fastapi. Implement create, list, get, update, and delete at /api/v1/todos. Use a real SQLite database and include executable tests that verify persistence. Generate exactly these files and no others: app/main.py, app/models.py, app/schemas.py, app/crud.py, tests/test_crud.py. Keep every local import inside this frozen file set.
